data.name: Afdhal
data.gender_notes: Afdhal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is excellent, perfect in every way. The name Afdhal carries the meaning “Excellent, Perfect” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Afdhal usually hope their child will grow to embody excellent, perfect and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Striving for perfection in one's actions and character
data.etymology: Afdhal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Excellent, Perfect.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Afdhal total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: أفضل
in_arabic.long_meaning: الأفضل هو اسم علم مذكر يعود إلى الجذر العربي أفضَل، ومعناه الأفضل والأعظم، ويستخدم في الإسلام لوصف الله تعالى، كما ذكر في القرآن الكريم، وفي الحديث النبوي، ويحمل اسم أفضل معنى روحاني عميق في الإسلام، يعبر عن التفوق والكمال

in_urdu.name: افضل
in_urdu.long_meaning: افضل ایک مذکہ نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے بہترین اور اعلیٰ، یہ نام عربي جڑ اَفضل سے ماخوذ ہے، اور اسلامی روایت میں اللہ تعالیٰ کی وصف کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے، اور یہ نام روحانی اور ثقافتی معانی کا حامل ہے

in_hindi.name: अफ़दल
in_hindi.long_meaning: अफ़दल एक पुरुष नाम है जिसका अर्थ है सर्वश्रेष्ठ और उत्तम, यह नाम अरबी मूल अَفضل से लिया गया है, और इस्लामी परंपरा में अल्लाह की विशेषता के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है, और यह नाम आध्यात्मिक और सांस्कृतिक अर्थों से भरपूर है

in_pashto.name: افضل
in_pashto.long_meaning: افضل یو نوم دی چې معنا یې ښه او غوره دی، دا نوم د عربي رېښې اَفضل څخه اخیستل شوی، او په اسلامي دود کې د الله تعالى د وصف لپاره کارول کیږي، او دا نوم د رواني او کلتوري معنا څخه ډک دی

in_english.name: Afdhal
in_english.long_meaning: Afdhal is a male name that means the best and most excellent, derived from the Arabic root أَفضل, and used in Islamic tradition to describe Allah, and this name carries deep spiritual and cultural significance in Muslim cultures and traditions

data.spiritual_significance: The name "Afdhal" is deeply rooted in the Islamic concept of striving for perfection, both in this world and the next. It encourages the bearer to always strive for excellence in their deeds, character, and faith practices.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Excellent, Perfect" symbolizes One who is excellent, perfect in every way. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Afdhal serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of excellent, perfect.

modern_usage.modern_context: Afdhal is a popular name among Sufi communities and spiritual seekers in the modern world. His teachings and stories are shared widely on various digital platforms, inspiring people to deepen their spiritual practices and connect with their inner selves.
